coverage_limit: This is the nine-work reconciliation required by the 2026-07-22 independent rereview. It does not enlarge or relabel the original four-source 81-work universe.

rows.title: Speech-Copilot: Leveraging Large Language Models for Speech Processing via Task Decomposition, Modularization, and Program Generation
rows.route_reason: Training-free program generation over modular speech tools is a direct historical orchestration prior.

rows.title: AudioGPT: Understanding and Generating Speech, Music, Sound, and Talking Head
rows.route_reason: The task-planning and model-selection cascade is an early audio foundation-model orchestration prior.

rows.title: MM-ReAct: Prompting ChatGPT for Multimodal Reasoning and Action
rows.route_reason: This is the non-speech origin-domain boundary for central-LLM multimodal expert orchestration.

rows.title: EchoChain: A Full-Duplex Benchmark for State-Update Reasoning Under Interruptions
rows.route_reason: Interruption-conditioned state-update reasoning and its paired half-duplex control change the failure taxonomy.

rows.title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
rows.route_reason: Paired text-audio tool tasks preserve gold annotations and offer a lower-cost verifiable voice evaluation route.

rows.title: AuTAgent: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Tool-Augmented Audio Reasoning
rows.route_reason: Its learned tool gate is a training-dependent close boundary, not a training-free direct method.

rows.title: WavReward: Spoken Dialogue Models With Generalist Reward Evaluators
rows.route_reason: A trained speech-input IQ/EQ reward evaluator is an evaluator boundary and potential signal source, not a TF-Strict controller.

rows.title: SDiaReward: Modeling and Benchmarking Spoken Dialogue Rewards with Modality and Colloquialness
rows.route_reason: The trained multi-turn spoken-dialogue reward model exposes modality, colloquialness, preference and shift boundaries.

rows.title: GSRM: Generative Speech Reward Model for Speech RLHF
rows.route_reason: A human-rated reasoning-centric speech reward model is a trained evaluator boundary and naturalness comparator.
